scheme_name: Scheme for Conservation and Development of Indigenous Cattle and Murrah Development
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Haryana (or the jurisdiction where the animals are kept if different from residence, within Haryana)
The animal to be recorded must be between 5 and 75 days old from its calving date at the time of application
Only indigenous breeds are eligible: Hariana, Sahiwal or Belahi cows and Murrah buffaloes
A maximum of two milch animals (any combination of two cows, two buffaloes, or one of each) can receive incentive per applicant per year
Incentive can be provided to a particular animal only twice in its lifetime
Beneficiary must not sell the recorded animal or its male progeny for at least one year and must breed the animal through artificial insemination by the government
benefits_summary: Cash incentives up to ₹30,000 for Murrah buffaloes and up to ₹20,000 for indigenous cows based on lactation yield, with a one‑year restriction on sale of the animal and its male progeny.
